accesscontextmanager.folders.lookupConfi.reason: Looks up the VPC Service Controls perimeter configured for a Google Cloud folder; perimeters protect Cloud resources, not Workspace apps.

accesscontextmanager.operations.cancel.reason: Cancels a long-running operation named without any organization or policy, so its owner cannot be verified first; no access-context write that starts one is registered.

accesscontextmanager.operations.delete.reason: Deletes a long-running operation record named without any organization or policy, so its owner cannot be verified first.

accesscontextmanager.operations.get.reason: A long-running operation name carries no organization or policy, so it cannot be tied to the verified organization before it is read, and its response echoes changed resources.

accesscontextmanager.operations.list.reason: Lists long-running operations by a caller-supplied collection name that cannot be tied to the verified organization, and each response echoes changed resources.
